'''Hayashi Shrine''' (林神社) is a Shinto shrine located in Yorase, Tonami City, Toyama Prefecture. It is identified as a possible {{ill|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha}} listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho}}, though there is debate with another shrine in Hayashi, Tonami City, also bearing the same name. Currently, both shrines are considered "disputable sites" (論社) for the title.

== References ==
* Tonami City History Compilation Committee, *Tonami City History* (pp. 126–137), Tonami City, 1965.
